status: CAD-derived measurements of a community model; not Apple-certified; not yet compared with the physical phone

source.title: iPhone 11
source.author: Leonid (GrabCAD, Armenia)
source.author_claim: Accurate model of iPhone 11 according to Apple datasheet. Created in SolidWorks 2020.
source.licence: GrabCAD Website Terms of Use; no per-model licence stated

frame: X = width, Y = length (top end Y=0, Lightning end Y=-150.96), Z = thickness (front glass +Z)

body.correction: Earlier 75.74 x 150.98 figures were B-spline bounding boxes, not true extents; replaced by exact sections
body.side_profile: Rounded aluminium band: widest at z=-0.2, about 1.8 mm narrower per side at 3.5 mm from mid-thickness
body.plan_corner: B-spline blend spanning about 14 x 14.7 mm, not a single arc radius

camera_bump.limitation: Lens rings are not modelled proud of the plateau. Treat protrusion as under-modelled until measured.

lightning_opening.limitation: Simplified blind slot; no receptacle or plug engagement geometry

bottom_openings.grille_groups: Two groups of six 1.45 mm holes, X 14.48 to 27.21 and X 48.51 to 61.24
bottom_openings.other_holes: Two 1.5 mm holes at X 30.72 to 32.22 and 43.51 to 45.01, either side of Lightning (likely screw positions)
bottom_openings.limitation: Which grille is microphone and which is speaker is not identified by the model; holes are simplified blind cylinders

front_sensor_marks.limitation: Flat outlines engraved in the front glass plane, not true openings. Display active area and notch boundary are NOT modelled.

notes: The earpiece and sensor marks intrude up to 2.55 mm into the aperture at the top end, consistent with the notch remaining visible.
The R3 corners cannot be checked against the display boundary because the model has no display active area.

orientation: Sensors at Y=0 end, Lightning at Y=-150.96 end. With notch left in landscape, Lightning is on the right, matching the repo proposal.
